kv18.2:1.6: abhinimmito jino satthā sammāsambuddho sabbaññū sabbadassāvī dhammasāmī dhammapaṭisaraṇoti.
kv18.2:2.6: āyasmā ānando jino satthā sammāsambuddho sabbaññū sabbadassāvī dhammasāmī dhammapaṭisaraṇoti.
kv18.2:3.5: saṅkhittenapi kho ahaṃ sārīputta dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ
kv18.2:3.6: vitthārenapi kho ahaṃ sārīputta dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ
kv18.2:3.7: saṅkhittavitthārenapi kho ahaṃ sārīputta dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ
kv18.2:3.11: tena hi buddhena bhagavatā dhammo desitoti.
kv18.2:4.5: abhiññāyāhaṃ bhikkhave dhammaṃ desemi no anabhiññāya
kv18.2:4.6: sanidānāhaṃ bhikkhave dhammaṃ desemi no anidānaṃ
kv18.2:4.7: sappāṭihāriyāhaṃ bhikkhave dhammaṃ desemi no appāṭihāriyaṃ
kv18.2:4.8: yañca mayhaṃ bhikkhave abhiññāya dhammaṃ desayato no anabhiññāya sanidānaṃ dhammaṃ desayato no anidānaṃ sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desayato no appāṭihāriyaṃ karaṇīyo ovādo karaṇīyā anusāsanī
kv18.2:4.9: alañca pana vo bhikkhave tuṭṭhiyā alaṃ attamanatāya alaṃ somanassāya
kv18.2:4.10: sammāsambuddho bhagavā svākkhāto dhammo supaṭipanno saṅghoti
kv18.2:4.11: imasmiṃ ca pana veyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhaññamāne dasasahassī lokadhātu akampitthāti
kv18.2:4.14: tena hi buddhena bhagavatā dhammo desitoti.
